en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing powerful river rapids rushing toward the viewer, with rocky banks and trees on the left. A truss bridge spans the water near the middle distance, with industrial-style buildings behind it on the right and left banks. The card has a printed white border and caption text at the bottom reading 'Trollhättan.' on the left and 'Östra GullöfalIet.' on the right.
